Data Privacy Statement
Dear Candidate:

If this is your first time to “My Profile”, you will have the opportunity to add details that will be saved and is viewable as well as searchable by Human Resources and Hiring Managers. Any field with an * is required in order to save your profile and application. Although all fields are not required, it is beneficial to provide as much information as possible.

Once you create your Profile, you may use the tabs at the top to search for available jobs at Amkor Technology, which is highly recommended.

If you are applying for a specific opening and have come to your Profile page, this is simply an opportunity for you to update your information. Please be sure to click “Next” at the bottom to complete the application process for the specific position you are interested in.

Thank you,

Amkor HR Staffing & Recruitment
